title: docs(ui-merge): fold objectui.org into objectstack docs, K4 — retire ui/apps/site and ui/content/docs, 301 every objectui.org path to objectstack.ai/docs, drop the deploy-ui-site job
body:
Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed). In the "Restore objectui.org docs deploy" project thread (card thread of #26993), on 2026-10-28:

- 03:24Z, on the decision card "objectui.org 文档站以后怎么处理?", Tesla chose 「B 并入 objectstack 文档站」. www.objectui.org stops being a separate site, and its docs fold into the objectstack docs site (`content/docs`, served at objectstack.ai/docs).
- 03:24Z, Tesla asked 「objectui 文档全部需要保留吗？这需要评估并和我沟通」. The card thread then sorted the 183 pages under `ui/content/docs` one by one into keep, merge, generate and delete, and put four questions to Tesla.
- 07:58Z, on that evaluation, Tesla answered 「VS Code 扩展 不会发布，其他同意」 and then 「你负责派卡执行」.

The fold is split into four cards. The first three can run in parallel; the fourth is blocked by them:
- **K1** (#27140) moves the SDK pages. On the maintainer's 2026-10-28 11:02Z ruling 「新入口 + 方案 B」, they live in a new entry, `content/docs/frontend/` ("Custom front-end"), trimmed after a per-page duplication review. #27168's body has the final 95-row table.
- **K2** (#27141) merges pages into existing ones.
- **K3** (#27142) generates the component reference.
- **K4** retires the old site and adds the redirects.

This is card **K4**.

Blocked-by: #27140, #27141, #27142

## 维护者速读

K1–K3 把内容搬完后,本卡收尾,做四件事:

- 删掉旧站点:`ui/apps/site` 和 `ui/content/docs`。
- 加跳转:objectui.org 的每个旧路径都 301 到 objectstack.ai/docs 的新位置,旧链接不断。
- 删掉根 `docs-deploy.yml` 里的 `deploy-ui-site` 作业,也就是 #27005 加的那个。从现在到它删掉之前,它每 6 小时都会红在 Root Directory 那一步。
- 把 37 个包的 `homepage` 和 README 里指向 objectui.org 的链接改到新地址。

本卡改了 `.github/workflows/**`,属 Tier H;删除的行数也远超 3000 行人工合并门槛,所以需要你批准合并。

合并之后有一个只能你做的动作,记在 #27030:把 objectui.org 和 www.objectui.org 两个域名挪到 objectstack 的 Vercel 项目上,跳转才会生效;之后再删掉 Vercel 项目 `objectui`。

## Wanted

1. **Redirect map.** Every published path of the old site goes to its new home:
   - Sources: the old → new tables in the PR bodies of #27140, #27141 and #27142.
   - Pages that are deleted outright redirect to the nearest section index.
   - Host-based rules: requests whose host is `objectui.org` or `www.objectui.org` redirect `/docs/<old path>` to `https://objectstack.ai/docs/<new path>`, with 301s, and every other path on that host goes to `/docs/frontend`.
   - Put them in `apps/docs/redirects.mjs`, or beside it with `has: [{ type: 'host', … }]`, so `check-docs-redirects` keeps holding one table.
   - The rules are inert until the domains move (#27030), so they can land first.
   - The pages deleted outright are:
     - `blocks/*` (6 pages);
     - `guide/{architecture,console-architecture,objectos-integration,deployment,release-notes,schema-playground,schema-catalog}` and `guide/index`;
     - `utilities/{runner,vscode-extension,index}` and `api/index`;
     - `plugins/{plugin-calendar-view,plugin-ai,plugin-designer}`;
     - `components/{feedback/toaster,layout/semantic}`.
   
   Chain trap: #27179 retires `content/docs/ui/{setup-app,console,studio}`. It redirects `/docs/ui/console` and `/docs/ui/studio` to `/docs/build-without-code`, and `/docs/ui/setup-app` to `/docs/ui/apps`. Any row in #27170's table that targets one of those three pages must aim at the final page (or the specific `apps`/`views` anchor), or `check-docs-redirects` reds on a chain.

   `rfcs/0001-clipboard-paste` and `guide/console-architecture` are design records rather than user docs: move them to `ui/docs/` instead of deleting them.
2. **Delete the old site.** Remove these:
   - `ui/apps/site`, and `ui/content/docs` after its pages are on `main` in their new homes.
   - The `deploy-ui-site` job in `.github/workflows/docs-deploy.yml`, plus its header lines.
   - Any CI step that builds or checks `@object-ui/site` or the `ui/content/docs` routes. Today that is the docs-route closure gate in `Lint UI`, the site build in `Build & E2E UI`, and `ci.yml`'s `ui/content/docs/**` filter comment.
   
   Leave the `apps/docs` job unchanged.
3. **Re-point the readers.** 46 files under `ui/scripts/` read `ui/content/docs` paths: `markdown-test-inputs.mjs` rows, doc-example type checks, JSON-fence checks and doc tests.
   - A reader that guards the SDK pages' examples, such as the example type-check or the JSON-fence check, follows them to `content/docs/frontend/`.
   - A reader that only pinned the old site is deleted with it.
   - A reader must not be left pointing at a missing file. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` passes.
4. **Links.**
   - Change the `homepage` field of the 37 `package.json` files that name objectui.org to the package's page under `https://objectstack.ai/docs/frontend/`.
   - Change the 38 Markdown files outside `ui/content` that link objectui.org, the root README among them, to the new URLs.
   - Change `ui/apps/console/plugin.ts` `homepage` the same way.
   - Do not touch `objectui.org` in comments that record history, such as `ui/packages/cli/src/commands/check.ts`'s `$schema` ruling note, or in test fixtures that exercise host matching.
5. **Spelling.** Change "Object UI" to "ObjectUI" in the `description` fields of `ui/packages/*/package.json`. There are 44 occurrences on 2026-10-28 (`grep -o "Object UI" ui/packages/*/package.json`), and this item edits the same files as item 4. Tesla agreed to it at 11:40Z in #27140's card thread (「同意」), after K1 #27168 adopted the "ObjectUI" spelling at Tesla's question.
6. **Supersede #26993.** Its goal was that www.objectui.org serves from the merged repo; it now does so by redirect. The PR body says `Part of #26993`, and the seat closes #26993 once the redirects answer on the live domain.

## Who acts

A `domain:devx` card thread, after #27140, #27141 and #27142 have merged.

- The surface is `ui/apps/site/**`, `ui/content/docs/**`, `ui/docs/**`, `ui/scripts/**`, `.github/workflows/{docs-deploy,ci,lint}.yml`, `apps/docs/redirects.mjs` (or `next.config.mjs`), the `package.json` `homepage` lines and the Markdown link lines.
- The PR is Tier H by path: it stays draft until green, GOVERNED_APPROVERS review it, the maintainer merges, and the seat never enqueues it.
- After the merge comes the maintainer action on #27030, rescoped there: move both domains onto the `objectstack` Vercel project, check one old URL, then delete the `objectui` project.

**Business reason.** Every link to www.objectui.org (npm package pages, READMEs, search results, old issues) keeps working after the separate site goes away. The fleet stops carrying a second docs app, its CI lanes and a deploy job that is red every 6 hours.

## Acceptance

- `git grep -n "objectui.org" -- ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'` lists only history comments and host-matching fixtures, each named in the PR body.
- `git grep -n "ui/apps/site\|ui/content/docs"` lists nothing outside CHANGELOG history.
- The redirect map has a row for every path in #27140's, #27141's and #27142's tables plus each deleted page, and `check-docs-redirects` is green.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` is green, the `apps/docs` build is green, and a Docs Deploy run after the merge has only the `apps/docs` job.
- After the #27030 domain move, `curl -sI https://www.objectui.org/docs/guide/quick-start` answers 301 to the new SDK page. The maintainer or a seat whose network allows the host records this on #26993.

**Duplicate search.** The same query as the fold's other cards: 33 hits, the first 10 read (#26993, #27030, #27048, #26140, #26688, #24230, #25677, #26944, #25854, #26035). #26993 and #27030 are this card's predecessors and are rescoped by it, not duplicated. **New.**

**Size:** L (mostly deletion). **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.
